description: This file defines the 'About' screen UI for the F-Droid Android app using Jetpack Compose, including header, text, links, and previews.

methods.name: About
methods.description: Main composable function for the About screen, with optional back button callback.

methods.name: AboutContent
methods.description: Displays the main content of the About screen, including header and text.

methods.name: AboutHeader
methods.description: Displays the app icon and version information.

methods.name: AboutText
methods.description: Displays the about text and links.

methods.name: AboutLink
methods.description: Creates a clickable link with icon and text.

methods.name: AboutPreview
methods.description: Previews the About screen in light mode.

methods.name: AboutPreviewDark
methods.description: Previews the About screen in dark mode.
